newsitem.title: UK: Pipeline to Russia's Novorossiisk to reopen Monday.
newsitem.headline: Pipeline to Russia's Novorossiisk to reopen Monday.

text.p: A crude pipeline feeding Russia's leading oil export terminal at Novorossiisk should reopen later on Monday after closing last week for repairs, a shipping source said.
The 650,000 barrel per day (bpd) line was shut early on December 19. It was unclear exactly when on Monday afternoon it would reopen, the source added.
The Black Sea port's largest berth, which has been shut since December 9 for maintenance, was due to open again on December 24.
Loadings at other berths were disrupted over the weekend due to high winds and swell but the port reopened again at 1600 (local time) on Sunday, the shipping source said.
Six crude tankers and one gas oil vessel were at anchor outside the port.
Other Black Sea ports at Odessa and Tuapse and at Ventspils on the Baltic were also operating normally on Monday, the source added.
